single_question: Do non-capacity baseline losses primarily look like entry-quality failures or exit-protection failures?

path_definition.bars: open_time >= filled entry timestamp through the exit bar, inclusive
path_definition.mae_r: (minimum bar low - filled entry) / (filled entry - original stop)
path_definition.mfe_r: (maximum bar high - filled entry) / (filled entry - original stop)
path_definition.time: first bar containing the extreme; 4h OHLC cannot establish intrabar ordering
path_definition.early_window: first six 4h bars (24h) for descriptive fast-entry diagnostic
path_definition.entry_quality_like: loss with early MAE <= -0.5R, early MFE < 0.5R, and MAE reached within six bars

verdict_reason: 快速 MAE/低早期 MFE 的损失在早窗较多、近窗很少；足够 MFE 后回吐的损失在两个窗口都出现，但数量少且不是多数，现有样本不能把主要亏损稳定归因到入场或退出。
